_about: Rules table of the Installer USB Builder (plan principle 3). Joost maintains it; the Lab can read it.
Nothing reaches a delivery USB unless a rule here names it (principle 5, allowlist).
status 'use' = goes on the USB. status 'toCheck' = listed for a human with the proposed file, NOT copied (principle 8, better nothing than wrong).
'basis' records the evidence: 'n/m' = on n of the m mapped reference USBs that could have it (plan: Draft rules table, Reference installers 2-6).
File references are '<root>:<path inside that root>'. A template file keeps its path on the USB; methods go to 06. Methods; certificates to 03. Certificates.
